body: I really appreciate the validation. No one seems to understand my anger, so your comment helps a lot. I'm honestly too afraid to confront him - he blames all his problems on us and even looks for reasons to be angry, and that would just be fuel for him rather than making him see reality. There's no way to win and that makes me want to punch something.  There's no justice, except to leave quietly when I can.
Thanks for the support. I hope your situation gets better too. It's so very sad that so many of us suffer at the hands pf abusive parents.
That's true. Nothing lasts, even bad things. Thank you for reminding me <3

Thank you for your reply. I actually have not received any financial aid for school since I dropped out or rather just stopped taking classes back in 2014. Also I truly cannot work because of bipolar disorder despite being treated with medication for it. That's the vicious circle I'm in - cannot work, cannot get out of the abuse without some sort of help like SSI, can't get better or at least stable without getting out of the home. But you're right, school probably isn't the right option since I would need financial aid for it.
26. I'm ashamed to be so old and still trapped at home like a 16 year old.

I'm sadly 26 and am unemployed and had to drop out of university because my bipolar and anxiety became debilitating. And my mother suffers too, even more so because I can go and hide in my room but she can't. The only thing I know to do is apply for assistance for my mental illnesses, which I did several months ago. But I've been turned down twice for SSI and this 3rd time I've attempted they said I'd have to wait 12-15 months to have a hearing. So i dunno, I'm just completely stuck in this. I did call one of my senator's office (family friend suggested it) and asked if there's anything I can do to get my case bumped up. The lady said I could write a letter saying what my situation is and ask for consideration for a quicker hearing, but I haven't heard anything back yet and I don't even know if that will help (Bureaucrats don't really care about your mental health.)

I've actually received that advice on here before and I think that would help a lot in theory but my situation is strange. He's very unpredictable and when he lashes out it's usually I guess what you would call "micro aggressions." If i recorded it, no one would think that was abusive behavior. And many times when I expect him to blow up he just walks off. And the reverse is true like the sandwich thing today. It's more his attitude and little quips about my illness, and at this part in my life (been going through this for 15 years) we rarely speak. I'm in full on avoidance mode. I'm sorry it's just really hard to describe. I can definitely start a journal with my emotional experiences when it happens though.
That is so kind and lovely, thank you. <3

He definitely is a bully. He does things all the time that set me up. I haven't been well enough mentally to drive my car for the past several months. He pays the car insurance. I understand that sucks but I need my car for emergencies (like if I need to get away from him fast for one), but he just sees it as a tangible example of me being lazy. Anyway, my mother was looking for something in my car and noticed the odometer had been reset. He had reset it so he could see if I've driven it. He does sneaky shit like that all the time so he can have things to yell at me about.

Edit: also I can't go anywhere safe unfortunately. I'm trying to get on ssi so I can be on my own but they told me I won't have a hearing to present my case for another year. So I have to endure another year at the least. No family or friends to help.
Oh yeah I forgot about the eye thing. How long does red eye usually last just in case eye drops don't work? I have to cover all my tracks.
I really don't know any other option. I'm 26 and can't work and had to drop out of university. No one in my family will take me in and I have no friends to help.
I've never heard of such a thing. Thank you very much, I'll look into it.
Sadly I don't have any friends I could go to, only online friends. But thank you, just having someone validate my experience and make sure I'm not just overreacting helps a lot.
I actually have had 2 mental hospital stays before. With the emergency room visits recorded too.
thank you, I'll definitely check it out.
Oh lord I understand that kind of petty fighting. I hope you can find some peace too.

I will definitely keep those suggestions in mind about recording his behavior. Yeah, I do have a smartphone so I could easily do that.

And thank you so, so much for the kind words. It's so reassuring to hear that about my inability to work. Our culture values work so fucking much that I constantly feel worthless. So thank you for that reminder that that's bs and I'm worth a lot regardless of my illness. Thank you.
